notes: Backend remains authoritative for app identity, environment, and analysis-ready state.
Customer remains owner of Google Play / developer accounts.
Google Play submission automation is Phase 3 and out of scope for this contract.

steps.title: Add GitHub Packages Maven repository
actions: Add maven { url = uri("https://maven.pkg.github.com/geeklab-ltd/audiencelab_android_sdk") } with gpr.user / gpr.key credentials from Gradle properties or CI secrets.
Do not commit GitHub Packages tokens to source control.

steps.title: Pin the deterministic Maven coordinate
actions: Keep the version exact for certification; do not use dynamic + or latest ranges.

steps.title: Inject AudienceLab API key without committing secrets
actions: Provide the application API key via BuildConfig, local.properties, CI secret, or equivalent sealed config.
Prefer a one-time / short-lived credential handoff from the entitled workspace (GEE-481).
Never write the raw key into ordinary logs, analytics events, shared audit payloads, screenshots, or committed files.

steps.title: Initialize AudienceLabSDK early in app startup
actions: Call AudienceLabSDK.initialize(context, apiKey, options) from Application.onCreate or equivalent early startup.
Set isDevelopmentMode and isDebugEnabled from build type; default autoResolveGooglePlayIds = true unless restricted-network.

fallbacks.title: Install from release AAR
actions: Download audiencelab-sdk-release-1.1.11.aar from the android-v1.1.11 GitHub release.

notes: The shipped AAR declares minSdkVersion 23 and does not add extra host permissions beyond what the host app must declare for network access.

Advertising ID / App Set ID resolution uses reflective Play Services lookup when those classes already exist in the host app; no mandatory Google Play Services dependency is required by this contract.

credentials.delivery: Authorized agent may retrieve the full application API key for the entitled workspace/app via a short-lived or one-time handoff. Prefer host secret injection over durable chat transcripts when available.
storage: Gradle BuildConfig field populated from local/CI secrets
Encrypted device/keystore-backed config for production apps when applicable
forbidden: Raw long-lived API keys in MCP ordinary tool results that are logged
Raw keys in app logs, crash reports, analytics events, or shared audit payloads
Committed keys in git, screenshots, issue comments, or PR descriptions
inspection: Presence / rotated / expired confirmation APIs are allowed for non-secret status.
AudienceLabSDK.getConfiguredApiKeyPreview() may be used for redacted local diagnostics only.

entrypoints: AudienceLabSDK.initialize(context: Context, apiKey: String, options: AudienceLabOptions = AudienceLabOptions()): Boolean
AudienceLabSDK.init(context: Context, apiKey: String, options: AudienceLabOptions = AudienceLabOptions()): Boolean
initialization.timing: Call before first event emission and as early as practical in Application startup.
initialization.success_predicate: initialize(...) returns true AND AudienceLabSDK.isInitialized() == true

automatic.how: SDK tracks session start/end with a 30-minute timeout after initialize when metrics are enabled.
automatic.notes: No app call required beyond successful initialize with metrics enabled.

automatic.how: SDK emits retention markers; first-launch day is 0.
SDK calls POST {baseUrl}/fetch-token after initialize and retries as needed.
automatic.notes: Event delivery is gated on a valid creative token.

minimum_for_certification.how: App initializes SDK with a valid environment API key and obtains a creative token.
App emits at least one of sendCustomEvent, sendPurchaseEvent, or sendAdEvent after token availability.

recommended.how: AudienceLabSDK.sendPurchaseEvent(itemId, itemName, value, currency, status, transactionId)
AudienceLabSDK.sendAdEvent(adId, name, source, watchTime, reward, mediaSource, channel, value, currency)
After Purchases.configure and before first paywall, call Purchases.sharedInstance.setAttributes(AudienceLabSDK.getRevenueCatAttributes()).

rules: The host app owns user-facing privacy disclosures, Google Play Data safety declarations, and advertising-ID consent UX.
Do not enable advertising-ID collection paths that violate the host app's declared consent state.
When Google Play Services ID lookup may stall or consent is unavailable, set autoResolveGooglePlayIds = false and supply consented identifiers only through setAdvertisingId / setAppSetId / providers.
Blacklisted email and phone user properties are normalized and SHA-256 hashed by the SDK before persistence or send.
Reserved underscore-prefixed whitelisted properties (for example _network) are AudienceLab-managed and must not be set manually.

safe_logging_rules: Log only previews from *DebugSnapshot / getConfiguredApiKeyPreview(); never log raw API keys or full creative tokens.
RequestDebugEntry.requestBody and responseBody must be redacted before leaving the device or entering shared logs.
Certification evidence must store boolean/status fields and previews, not secrets.

local_checks.description: Host app depends on exactly ai.audiencelab:audiencelab-android-sdk:1.1.11 or the matching release AAR.
local_checks.pass_when: resolved version == package.sdk_version AND runtime getSdkVersion() == package.sdk_version

local_checks.description: API key is not committed to the integrating repository.
local_checks.pass_when: secret_storage_mechanism is non-vcs AND vcs_secret_scan_passed == true

runtime_checks.description: SDK initialize returns true and isInitialized is true.
A valid creative token was obtained for the configured environment.
At least one certification signal was queued/sent without runtime failure.
runtime_checks.pass_when: signals_emitted length >= 1 AND runtime_errors is empty

backend_checks.description: Backend/MCP reports at least one accepted signal for the app/environment within the freshness policy window.
backend_checks.pass_when: accepted_signal_count >= 1 AND freshness_ok == true AND environment matches credential environment

backend_checks.description: No blocking schema/environment validation failures remain.

pass_criteria: All blocking backend_checks pass for the target environment when certifying analysis readiness.
No raw API key or full creative token appears in evidence or agent logs.

steps: Pin or restore the previous known-good Maven/AAR version in the host app Gradle files.
Remove or no-op AudienceLabSDK.initialize and event call sites if fully uninstalling.
Rotate the application API key if it may have been exposed during a failed integration attempt.
Rebuild the host app and re-run verification evidence generation against the restored version.
Record rollback evidence: previous_version, new_version, key_rotated, verification_rerun_passed.
compatibility_notes: 1.1.x Android public API is intended to remain additive within the 1.1 line.
Dynamic version ranges are forbidden for certified integrations because rollback and attestation require a deterministic package version.

out_of_scope: Google Play Console submission automation (Phase 3 / GEE-527)
Signed CI artifact attestation pipeline (Phase 3 / GEE-528)
Unity or iOS native contracts (GEE-516 / GEE-510)
Changing SDK runtime behavior in this documentation repository
